meta.title: Staged Overdose at St. Jude Harbor: Cassandra Ward
meta.incidentLocation: Pier 14 Terminal Overlook, St. Jude Harbor Marina
meta.discipline: Forensic Pathology, Questioned Documents & Vitreous Chemistry
meta.medicalExaminer: Dr. Rebecca Lin, MD, FCAP (Chief Medical Examiner)
meta.summary: At 05:15 UTC, harbor patrol discovered senior corporate auditor Cassandra Ward deceased in driver's seat of her idling sedan. A printed note and open sedative vial were staged on the passenger seat. Post-mortem examination revealed conjunctival petechiae, hyoid cartilage fracture, and negative gastric drug levels, proving post-mortem relocation and mechanical asphyxiation.

intake.name: Cassandra Ward

belongingsInventory.description: Plastic amber vial with label intact; staged on passenger seat; interior dry with no pill residue
Single-sheet 20lb bond paper bearing laser-printed text without handwritten signature
Sterling silver chain, intact latch, unmarred

initialTriageVitals.lividity: Fixed posterior lividity with contradictory anterior blanching across chest belt
initialTriageVitals.rigor: Full rigor present in jaw, neck, trunk, and upper extremities
initialTriageVitals.pronouncingPhysician: Dr. Gregory Vance, MD (Coroner Field Physician)

intake.clinicalNotes: Adult female discovered in driver's seat of vehicle. Rigor mortis is fully established (typically requires 6-8 hours). Deep purple bilateral conjunctival petechial hemorrhages visible in both eyes.

diagnosticTests.clinicalInterpretation: Complete absence of sedative in decedent blood completely refutes death by oral prescription overdose.

diagnosticTests.quantitativeResult: NEGATIVE (Zero drug metabolites or excipient binder detected)
diagnosticTests.clinicalInterpretation: Stomach contents contain only partially digested dinner meal without pill binder, proving pills were never ingested.
Vitreous potassium demonstrates decedent died between 00:00 and 01:00 UTC, long before vehicle was driven to marina at 04:12 UTC.

traumaPoints.label: Bilateral Conjunctival Petechiae
traumaPoints.finding: Dense florid petechial hemorrhages throughout palpebral and bulbar conjunctivae of both eyes.
traumaPoints.evidentiaryValue: Hallmark indicator of acute cephalic venous hypertension from mechanical compression of neck / smothering.

traumaPoints.label: Hyoid Cartilage Microfracture & Laryngeal Contusion
traumaPoints.finding: Infiltration of hemorrhage into right thyroid cartilage horn with focal undisplaced fracture of greater horn of hyoid.
traumaPoints.evidentiaryValue: Conclusively establishes manual neck compression / homicidal manual strangulation.

pmiModel.corroboratingSource: Vitreous K+ & full rigor mortis refuting 04:12 marina vehicle entry
pmiModel.rigorStage: Fully established (3+ across all muscle groups)
pmiModel.livorStage: Dual-plane lividity indicating post-mortem body repositioning

deathCertificate.immediateCausePart1: Mechanical Asphyxia due to Manual Strangulation
deathCertificate.otherSignificantConditions: Post-mortem relocation and staging of scene

witnesses.name: Dr. Rebecca Lin, MD, FCAP
directTestimony: The decedent died between 00:00 and 01:00 UTC, over four hours before the car arrived at the marina.
Blood and gastric toxicology were completely negative for Zolpidem or sedatives.
Fracture of the hyoid horn proves direct manual compression of the neck.

crossExaminationQuestions.question: Could the hyoid bone have fractured from post-mortem handling?
crossExaminationQuestions.expectedAnswer: No. Vivid antemortem tissue extravasation and hemorrhage surrounding the fracture prove active circulation when sustained.
